The number of annual leave days an employee is entitled to depends on their years of service:
*   Less than five (5) years in service: 14 days [1, 4]
*   Five (5) to ten (10) years in service: 16 days [1, 4]
*   Ten (10) years and above in service: 18 days [1, 4]

An employee with less than one (1) year of service is entitled to annual leave on a pro-rated basis [2]. Up to five (5) days of the current year's leave entitlement can be carried forward to the following year and must be utilized by June of that year [2].

cases.query: How many days of maternity leave?
cases.answer: A female employee is entitled to sixty (60) days of maternity leave [2, 3]. This leave is consecutive and includes Rest Days and Public Holidays [2].
